title: Piercing Frame Solo #049 (일반 얼굴 컷 · P8 집중형 · 일반 · 콘로우 · 비비드마젠타 · 메이크업 비주얼계 · 금속 황동·보석 루비)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — pale porcelain skin, deep smoky black eyeshadow blended far out beyond the eyes, a sharp black winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy black lips, sharply contoured cheekbones, a cold, poised expression, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp. Real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded.

Piercings: All eight piercings gather on the left side of her face, and the right side stays bare: on the left ear five pieces — a big antique-brass stud in the lobe, two smaller antique-brass rings above it, a thick antique-brass bar and a small antique-brass stud at the top; two antique-brass pieces in a row along the outer end of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a small antique-brass ring passes through the left nostril. Each piece carries small rubies set into the metal. All jewelry is real antique brass, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Lighting: a soft frontal beauty light on the face with a thin cool rim light along the hair, pure pitch black void background, shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
